name: r1-e1-lt-fasttf32-bias-scatter
author: solx-loop
description: One cuBLASLt FAST_TF32 GEMM (tcgen05, fp32 accumulate over full K) with the bias epilogue into tmp[B,18432], plus the scatter kernel, replaces every r0 path (skinny SIMT, fp32 FFMA, 3xTF32 with split pass). Under the plain-TF32 ruling this is the anchor at the hidden baseline's speed class. The batched pointer-array one-launch fusion (H11 second half) does not pay: it is slower than the big GEMM plus scatter at every B, so the scatter stays and the fusion moves to E2.
